subject: general
question: Name the state government that announced its decision to ban production, distribution, advertisement and sale of e-cigarette within its territory in May 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajasthan** announced its decision to ban the production, distribution, advertisement, and sale of e-cigarettes within its territory in May 2019.
 
• This move was part of the state's efforts to curb the usage of e-cigarettes, which were increasingly becoming popular, especially among the youth.
 
• The ban was implemented to address health concerns associated with e-cigarettes, including potential risks of addiction and other health issues.
 
• Rajasthan's decision was in line with the growing global and national trend of regulating or banning e-cigarettes due to their health implications.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **E-cigarettes** are battery-operated devices that heat a liquid to create an aerosol, which typically contains nicotine, flavorings, and other chemicals.
 
• Despite being marketed as a safer alternative to traditional cigarettes, e-cigarettes have been found to carry significant health risks, including lung injury and addiction.
 
• The Indian government has been proactive in regulating tobacco products and has taken steps to reduce the consumption of both traditional and electronic cigarettes.
 
• In September 2019, the Union Cabinet approved an ordinance to ban e-cigarettes across India, following Rajasthan's earlier decision.
